name: Seq log sink
tagline: Writes logs events to Serilog Seq

git.lastCommit: fe5d9b3 2026-07-15 ci: Auto update Github Action workflows

readme.overview: Seq log module collects application logging data in Seq.

notes.forAnalyst: Structured logs shipped to Seq, where they can be queried instead of grepped.
notes.forArchitect: A logging sink with no dependencies and no settings of its own — Serilog configuration in appsettings does the work. Structured logging is what makes a scaled-out deployment debuggable.
notes.forDeveloper: Log properties, not sentences: `{OrderId}` is queryable, an interpolated string is not. This module only decides where those events land.
reachForItWhen: You need to see what a deployed instance is doing
An incident needs traces or metrics that survive a restart
The hosting platform already collects this format
doNotReachForItWhen: Business reporting — this is operational telemetry, not analytics
You want an audit trail of who changed what: that is Audit Log
Adding several collectors for the same signal, which doubles cost for one answer
